root_cause.finding: Inherited numeric 20211103 RE snapshot is explicitly non-exhaustive; active sizeof-sent families can be absent even when numeric derive_table succeeds. Struct headers and final guards must be independently checked.

existing_documentation_evidence.text:
Spike 003-clientless-limbs: inherited packet snapshot with native corrections.

RECOVERY SCOPE
==============
The embedded numeric table was originally derived for 20211103 RE. The native
server actually builds with PACKETVER=20180704 MAIN/pre-re (config.log). Explicit
overrides below correct the packet families exercised by the four-limb test;
this is not an exhaustive regeneration. Numeric registrations alone exclude
struct-only S->C packets and final clif_shuffle.hpp mappings. Unknown receive IDs
now fail rather than inventing a two-byte frame. See README.md for live evidence.

Header and emitter code compiled/preprocessed with pinned config/core.hpp and actual packet flags. Emitter preprocessing strips #include directives only and includes compiled packet headers; it establishes active guards and lexical sizeof emission, not link/build or scenario reachability.

Scope regex includes broad item/skill/group classes; ancillary trade/mail/cart/MVP entries are inventory candidates, not ordinary-combat mandatory fixes. Names without an actual active direct emitter mapping stay unverified candidates.
Flexible [] definitions are variable prefixes. sizeof(prefix) MUST NOT become fixed wire length. Some apparent fixed-size buffers may also be variable; no blanket registration is approved.
No automatic 0088-as-arrival, no identity promotion from NPC name replies, unknown-ID rejection unchanged. Collector-consumed IDs cannot establish full stream coverage.

Compiled layouts validate only listed emitted families, not every protocol packet. Enum aliases, pointer senders, packet_len/WFIFO/raw literals and uncommon emitter types require separate review. No completeness claim.
